related: State CDL / emergency vehicle laws where applicable
standard.notes: Driver/Operator – Pumper covers safe driving, apparatus inspection, water supply, pump theory, and fireground pumping. Exact legal driving credentials (CDL, EVOC, etc.) are state and department dependent.

title: Driver/Operator – Pumper
description: Complete pump operator pathway: apparatus readiness, emergency driving foundation, hydraulics, water supply, and fireground pump operations.
audience: Firefighters preparing for engineer / driver/operator roles
Candidates for state or IFSAC/Pro Board driver/operator certification

estimatedRange.typicalHours: 40–80+ instructional hours plus documented driving/pumping time (varies widely)
estimatedRange.typicalDuration: 1–8 weeks formal course plus supervised ride time

prerequisites.title: Firefighter I or department equivalent
prerequisites.detail: Most systems expect structural firefighter foundation before pump operator qualification.

prerequisites.title: Valid driver’s license / required endorsements
prerequisites.detail: Must meet state and department rules (may include CDL, air brake endorsement, or emergency vehicle authorization).

prerequisites.title: Acceptable driving record
prerequisites.detail: Department policy usually requires a clean or acceptable MVR.

prerequisites.title: Medical / vision standards for driving
prerequisites.detail: Follow department and state commercial or emergency driver medical rules where applicable.

corequisitesAndCommonCompanions.title: Emergency Vehicle Operator Course (EVOC) or equivalent
corequisitesAndCommonCompanions.notes: Often separate from the pump certification itself but required to drive apparatus.

corequisitesAndCommonCompanions.title: Firefighter II
corequisitesAndCommonCompanions.notes: Some promotional or engineer tracks expect FF II first.

knowledgeDomains.title: Emergency driving principles
topics: Spotter use, backing, and space management
Adverse weather and night driving considerations

knowledgeDomains.title: Fire service hydraulics
topics: Pump discharge pressure determination methods used by the department

knowledgeDomains.title: Water supply operations
topics: Hydrant operations and supply line deployment
Water supply problem-solving on the fireground

knowledgeDomains.title: Pump operations and troubleshooting
topics: Transition from tank to external supply
Pressure control devices and governor use

jprSkillGroups.title: Apparatus inspection and readiness
skills: Verify pump, water, foam (if equipped), and safety systems readiness

jprSkillGroups.title: Apparatus driving and positioning
skills: Drive apparatus on public ways under supervision per policy
Position apparatus for supply and attack effectiveness

jprSkillGroups.title: Hydrant and supply operations
skills: Make hydrant connection and establish supply
Transition from booster tank to external source

jprSkillGroups.title: Drafting from static source
skills: Maintain draft under load as trained

jprSkillGroups.title: Pumping handlines and master streams
skills: Produce effective handline flows at correct pressure
Support master stream devices as equipped

jprSkillGroups.title: Hydraulics calculation / rule-of-thumb application
skills: Determine pump discharge pressure for assigned lines
Apply department calculation method or charts
Adjust for elevation, appliances, and layout changes

jprSkillGroups.title: Relay and problem-solving operations
jprSkillGroups.standardRef: NFPA 1002 – relay / water supply problem JPRs where included

trainingSequence.title: Confirm eligibility and driving authorization path
actions: Complete required EVOC or department driving course

trainingSequence.title: Hydraulics and pump theory
actions: Nozzle and line combinations used by the department

trainingSequence.title: Hands-on pump and water supply drills
Supervised driving and fireground pumping time
actions: Pump under supervision on drills and incidents as allowed
Receive engineer feedback and correct gaps

trainingSequence.title: Skills/written testing and certification
actions: Pass practical pump and driving evaluations
Obtain state / IFSAC / Pro Board driver/operator credential where offered

assessment.practical: Driving course, apparatus inspection, pump operations, water supply setups
assessment.written: Hydraulics, apparatus systems, water supply, and policy knowledge
assessment.passingCriteria: Set by state entity, accredited program, or department qualification process

stateOverlayGuidance.howToUse: Capture CDL rules, state driver/operator certification names, required EVOC standards, and whether national seals are issued.

sources.title: NFPA 1002 Fire Apparatus Driver/Operator professional qualifications

disclaimer: Structured training roadmap for personal professional development. Driving laws and department policies control actual authorization to operate apparatus.
